method: Read-only SSH inspection of tracked paths and existing file contents; SHA-256 compares exact bytes.

inventory_scope.category_selection: Case-insensitive keyword anywhere in tracked path, followed by input-extension filter.

artifact_presence_scan.scope_note: These counts describe this separate bounded scan, not the category union or entire repository.

limitations: File counts include workflow configurations, fragments and templates; they are not counts of independent runnable models.
Categories overlap and must not be added to infer a model total.
Identical hashes establish byte duplicates, not semantic equivalence of differently encoded models.
The inspected hull-seakeeping example is a naval-architecture screen, not a native OrcaFlex hull simulation.
The jumper-installation example references separate catalogs; complete dependency closure was not checked.
No native loadability, licence availability, engineering validity or generated-component-to-report integration was established.
Coverage is limited to the enumerated checkout and roots; it does not cover every machine, private dataset or untracked file.
